owner_decision.source_prompt: MASTER ENGINEERING EXECUTION PROMPT Revision 10.10 §0.2 OWNER_DECISION

exact_original_text_preserved: CapVer-only VERIFIED: every other role is rejected.
CURRENT → HISTORICAL on supersession; no in-place mutation.
Single CURRENT per cell under concurrency, on PostgreSQL.
No automatic population: an empty store evaluates to UNVERIFIED.
Seat isolation: no cross-seat or dual-pair inheritance.

technical_decision.decision: Accept CapVer-SQLite concurrency and CURRENT-uniqueness evidence as satisfying the dual-applicable intent of §8.23.8 for Phase 1 CapVer
does_not: Waive CapVer-only VERIFIED, freshness, supersession, rejection, empty-store, seat-isolation, or Cap≠IC≠Identity≠Activation clauses

cap_on_postgresql_current.rationale: Approved CapVer store is SQLite-by-design (DATABASE-AND-ARCHIVE-STORAGE-INVENTORY.md). Cap-on-PG CURRENT would reverse that boundary and is not authorized by §8.23.8 itself.

alternatives_evaluated.A: SELECTED — CapVer-SQLite evidence closes Cap CURRENT concurrency obligation for Phase 1 without Cap-on-PG migration
alternatives_evaluated.B: REJECTED — CapVer-on-PostgreSQL would reverse SQLite-by-design store ownership; requires new Implementation Authorization not granted by this owner decision
alternatives_evaluated.C: REJECTED — deferral would leave §8.23.8 unresolved despite owner authorization to remediate

exit09_effect: §8.23.8 Cap CURRENT item closed; EXIT-09 may remain PARTIAL for ServerRestart / residual regression scopes unrelated to this decision
